sources.title: 2026 inductee biography
sources.findings: Born February 27, 1971 Clearwater; footless control-top pantyhose, US patent 6,276,176; inducted 2026. FSU communications degree 1993; early fax-machine sales.
sources.caution: Induction year verified, not all historical first-ever invention or wealth superlatives adopted. Patent recognition does not imply she invented all shapewear. No patent validity opinion.

sources.title: 1 May 2026: honorary degree and commencement
sources.findings: Actual campus speech May 1, 2026 and Honorary Doctor of Humane Letters; communications bachelor graduated May 1, 1993.
sources.caution: Earned bachelor distinct from honorary doctorate; not research PhD. Read university report, not video.

sources.title: 18 November 2021: majority transaction closed
sources.findings: Funds completed majority investment at $1.2bn company valuation. Spanx founded 2000 with $5,000 savings. Blakely executive chair at closing.
sources.caution: Closing distinct from October agreement. Valuation not personal cash proceeds, not sale of all shares. Historical executive-chair title not asserted current solely from this release.

sources.title: 20 August 2024: Sneex launch
sources.findings: Founder introduced hybrid high-heel/sneaker brand and launched online sales.
sources.caution: Brand announcement, not independent comfort/medical validation. Earlier preview or website availability not official launch date; patent-pending is not granted patent.

sources.title: Founder story
sources.findings: Sara Blakely founded foundation in 2006 with support from Richard Branson; supports women through entrepreneurship, education and other fields.
sources.caution: Current name used; historical Sara Blakely Foundation not separate organization by inference. No independent audit of impact or current donation totals.

sources.title: 7 May 2013: new pledgers
sources.findings: Sara Blakely among new signatories committing half or more of wealth to charity.
sources.caution: Public commitment is not evidence entire pledged amount has been donated; announcement date not independently verified signature day.

sources.title: 13 May 2026: inventors gala report
sources.findings: Reports her attendance at National Inventors Hall of Fame gala and May 12 social post.
sources.caution: Publication May 13, not gala date. Read reporting, not original Instagram video; dress designs not independent evidence that every patent application was granted.
